recipe_note: uk-saas is a jurisdictional mismatch for this AU private-sector project. Excluded on this run: TCOP, SBD, DPIA, SVCASS, GOV_REUSE. ADR topics were retargeted from UK-specific framings (G-Cloud, GOV.UK One Login) to Australian equivalents (institutional procurement, APP 8). Consider authoring .arckit/recipes/au-private.yaml before further builds.

ADR-002.topic: Authoritative source for institutional role assignment

ADR-OBSERVABILITY.topic: Logging and observability stack for integrations
ADR-OBSERVABILITY.agent_summary: Chose layered observability plane (endpoint health / OpenTelemetry flow telemetry / entity-state reconciliation), vendor-neutral instrumentation, backend deferred to Principle 19 test. Layer 3 sequenced first as it works against today's estate pre-broker.

ADR-OSSLICENCE.topic: Open-source licence and third-party component policy
ADR-OSSLICENCE.agent_summary: Chose Register-and-Assess: extend capability map + RIFF checklist with licence_identifier, patch_and_support_owner, deployment_mode. Assessment depth set by deployment mode, not licence type. Estate has only two OSS components (H5P, MuseScore); copyleft obligations dormant, real exposure is operational.

ADR-TOPOLOGY.agent_summary: Chose single Australian region multi-AZ with cross-region recovery from code. Three tiers (prod/non-prod/sandpit) separated by subscription + identity boundary; PI prohibited outside production. Discharges ADR-001 Condition 2.

ADR-CLOUD.topic: Cloud platform selection for university-controlled workloads
ADR-CLOUD.agent_summary: Complements ADR-005 (which set region topology but deferred provider). Scoped to UoF-controlled integration plane, not vendor SaaS re-platforming. Agent was killed during final reporting; file written and validated by line count.

STRATEGY.agent_summary: Five themes partitioning SOBC one-off lines. Top: Governed Integration on a Canonical Model (AUD 1.25-2.25M, 56%); Declared Capability Boundaries (400-730k, 18%); Consistent Accessible Student Experience (300-550k, 14%). Flagged SOBC internal inconsistency in one-off:recurring ratio. Landed in project 001, not 000-global.

PLAN.agent_summary: Two-stage: Stage A engagement WP1-WP9 to 31 Aug 2026; Stage B indicative delivery programme Q4 2026-2028+, explicitly unfunded. RIFF gates G0-G6. Critical path 21-31 Aug has no float. Surfaced unlogged gap: SA departs 31 Aug with no scheduled knowledge transfer.

FINOPS.agent_summary: Reframed from cloud consumption to SaaS licence management. Levers: retire declared duplication (Teams/Zoom/Echo360); realise licensed-but-unconfigured capability; prevent net-new acquisition. Six of seven levers blocked behind the 2026-08-21 licence baseline. No dollar figures invented; 111 TBD-WP3 markers all closed out in section 17.

ORG_RESEARCH.topic: Target organisation strategy, structure, existing systems
ORG_RESEARCH.agent_summary: Agent killed during final reporting; file written. Recipe targeted 000-global/research/ but hook allocated projects/001-lt-ecosystem/research/. Needs review to confirm the fictional-organisation constraint was honoured (no fabricated enrolment/revenue facts).

ADR-IDENTITY.agent_summary: IdP as single enforcement plane: SAML/OIDC federation, MFA once at IdP, LTI 1.3 launch context, SCIM 2.0 event-driven deactivate consuming ADR-002 E-006. Three-outcome disposition for the two local-account platforms. Named admin accounts + vaulted break-glass. 6 conditions. Notes MFA maturity NOT raised, only its exception removed.

ADR-RESIDENCY.agent_summary: Governed accountable offshore disclosure. Four-tier class rule: Tier 0 absolute prohibition for sensitive info (class 5 placement); Tier 1 full-assessment (class 3 work, class 6 exam/proctoring); Tier 2 minimised (class 7, class 4); Tier 3 AU-and-to-remain. Six-question APP 8 assessment, standard cross-border schedule incl. certified destruction. Found REQ gap: NFR-I-002/DR-007 cover retrieval but not recipient destruction (Condition 4).
ADR-RESIDENCY.topic: Data residency and cross-border disclosure under APP 8

ADR-AI.agent_summary: Advisory-only inference under human-determinative process + governed AI/ML service register. No AI output determinative; no threshold gate on marking; cohort-disaggregated equity monitoring with suspension trigger; no training on student work. ERROR TO FIX: agent asserted 'no RISK register exists' and held RISK-A1-A12 in-document, but ARC-001-RISK-v1.0 has 28 R-xxx entries. Migrate those risks.
ADR-AI.topic: AI and ML services in the learning ecosystem

ADR-BUILDBUY.agent_summary: Staged sourcing hierarchy: Realise -> Extend -> Aggregate (consortium) -> Buy -> Build, binding on RIFF gate and renewals. Exhaust licensed capability first. References ADR-001 Condition 1 as worked Gate 1 example. Warning: 3-option cap meant no standalone build option; may want 4-option revision.
ADR-BUILDBUY.topic: Build versus buy and procurement approach

GLOSSARY.agent_summary: PLUGIN BUG: hook rejected ARC-001-GLOS-v1.0.md — 'GLOS' absent from config/doc-types.mjs though commands/glossary.md:105 specifies it. Written as GLOSSARY.md with canonical ID in Document Control. NOT discoverable by ArcKit tooling (ARC-* prefix). ~93 terms, 34 acronyms.

WARDLEY.agent_summary: Distinct from WARD-001 (whole-estate, 3 anchors): maps the PeopleSoft-to-platforms data path. Findings: chain is inverted (9 flows avg evolution 0.264 vs substrate 0.662); broker is NOT where risk is (none of 13 edges above R=0.5 pass through it) — Declared Role Authority and Conflict Resolution Rule are decisions, belong in Phase 0; conflict C-1 splits into substrate vs endpoint-count decisions; INT-007 under-prioritised (MEDIUM but R=0.722).

RESEARCH.agent_summary: BUY managed on Azure australiaeast: Service Bus Standard + Event Hubs Standard (Schema Registry unavailable on Basic, so Standard is an architectural floor for DR-001). Self-host rejected as building a commodity; Confluent held as contingency with written trigger. FINDING: ADR-001/006 Condition 1 will fail as worded — a MACC is a spend commitment not an entitlement, and M365 A3/A5 Power Automate excludes Azure premium connectors. FINDING: SOBC broker line $80-150k/yr is 3-7x high vs project 004's A$63-105k/3yr. Badging: 'Milestone' is Anthology Milestone (OB 3.0 US-only at 2025-07-30); Badgr became Parchment Digital Badges (2025-10-31), Canvas-coupled. Deferred spawning 6 vendor profiles + 4 tech notes (write restriction).
RESEARCH.topic: Technology and vendor market research (build vs buy, TCO)

AWS_RESEARCH.reason: ADR-006 selected Microsoft Azure; AWS/GCP research redundant. GCP also lacks GOOGLE_API_KEY.

AZURE_RESEARCH.agent_summary: 12 findings, 4 HIGH contradicting ADRs. CONFIRMED ADR-006: australiaeast has AZs, australiasoutheast does not (ADR-005 A-2 discharged). F-1 HIGH: Azure Monitor Logs has NO service resilience in any AU region — observability plane less zone-resilient than the broker it observes, inverting ADR-005 s7.2; dedicated cluster does not fix it. F-2 HIGH: 'telemetry but no PI at rest' in recovery region is self-contradictory — ADR-003 s6.4 classifies telemetry as CONFIDENTIAL derived PI; fix via export to GZRS storage. F-3 HIGH: Entra MFA stores identity data in global/US datacentres — ADR-006's 'APP 8 avoided' claim is wrong, ADR-008 has no residency condition. F-4 HIGH: CAE does not reach vendor SaaS and non-CAE CA changes take up to 24h — ADR-008's 15-min revocation unachievable via Entra alone. Also: Event Grid documents possible zone-failure data loss; Schema Registry validation is client-SDK-side so ADR-001's 'enforced at runtime' needs restating; PIM needs Entra P2. Note CCSL ceased Jul 2020 — IRAP used instead.
AZURE_RESEARCH.topic: Azure service availability + patterns, australiaeast/australiasoutheast (recipe UK regions overridden per ADR-006)

GCP_RESEARCH.reason: ADR-006 selected Microsoft Azure; AWS/GCP research redundant. GCP also lacks GOOGLE_API_KEY.

HLD.agent_summary: APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS — 8 blocking, 9 advisory, 6 informational. Reviewed the 10 ADRs + DATA + STRAT as the design (no separate HLD exists). BLOCKING-06: E-020 audit-event store has no hosting decision (DATA requires RPO 0, 7-year immutable, but ADR-006 omits it, ADR-003 excludes it from telemetry, ADR-005 permits no durable state) — NFR-C-003 is MUST_HAVE. BLOCKING-02: ADR-009's false risk-register claim. BLOCKING-03/04: ADR-001 Condition 1 unrun gates 4 decisions; NFR-A-001 chain arithmetic never shown (serial gives ~99.75% vs 99.9% target). Also found ADR-001/002 cite superseded PRIN-v1.0, and both reserve ADR-003 for course-cloning — collision with observability, leaving R-007 undecided. Coverage 60/64; FR-003/006/008/012 uncovered.

DEVOPS.agent_summary: Scoped honestly to the 6 ADR-006 components + course-cloning as the only deployable surface; states which estate segments have no pipeline and why. IaC as the DR control (ADR-005 recovery-from-code) with scheduled dr-rehearsal into australiasoutheast and zone-agnostic overrides. Synthetic-data-only non-prod, structurally enforced. Pipeline as enforcement point for canonical-schema back-compat (DR-001) and ADR-004 attributes; OIDC federated identity, no stored credentials. Kubernetes/GitOps/IDP declined with re-open triggers. Raises a real ML2-patch-window vs NFR-A-002 freeze conflict needing ratification. E8 ML2 gap on capture appliances and lab fleets explicitly NOT closed.

ROADMAP.agent_summary: 3 Australian financial years FY2026/27-FY2028/29 (re-based to Jul-Jun from the template's UK Apr-Mar). Stage A reproduced unchanged; Stage B Phases 0-5 labelled unfunded and contingent on Gate 4 throughout. ADOPTED WARD-002's resequencing challenge in its own section: Declared Role Authority (0.14) moved from ADR-001 Phase 2 to programme Phase 0; Conflict Resolution Rule (0.24) from Phase 4 to Phase 1; A-3 PeopleSoft-change-events becomes a 2-week Phase 0 spike parallel to the Principle 19 test; INT-007 pulled from Phase 3 to Phase 2 on R=0.722. No downstream date moves. Phase 1 worded 'broker confirmed or procured' to survive either Condition 1 outcome. WARNING: knowingly diverges from ADR-001's published phasing — needs RIFF/Steering acknowledgement at G5.

DIAG-C4.agent_summary: 3 Mermaid blocks: two native C4Context (actor context; system landscape naming all 16 platforms, 3 institutional systems inside the boundary vs 7 System_Ext groups) plus a flowchart current-state overlay of the 7 integrations with red/amber fragility coding. Differs from DIAG-001 (Level 2 target-state containers as flowchart with hand-applied C4 palette): this is Level 1, native C4Context, full actor set, and draws CURRENT state with the vendor-SaaS/institutional-control split as the subject. New findings: 7 platforms covered by no INT requirement AND no Wardley position; Allocate+ is a system of record outside the control boundary; only 1 of the mediation layer's 3 inbound sources is even claimed able to emit events. All 3 blocks parse OK under mermaid@11.16.0.

DIAG-SEQ.agent_summary: 5 Mermaid sequence diagrams across 3 flows. (1) Enrolment to LMS access, target state, with ADR-001 assumption A-3 drawn as a critical/option block per WARD-002. (2) De-provisioning on withdrawal: current-state 24h window as a loop with --x showing the batch never reaching Echo360/Sonia, plus target state; 15-min SCIM claim marked contested against AZRS F-4 — conclusion drawn on the diagram that directory state is corrected in 15 min but access is not necessarily stopped. (3) Placement grade flow, manual re-keying vs target, incl. the email/screenshot path ARC-001-DATA prohibits. Classified OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE because current-state diagrams draw an exploitable window and a live sensitive-information leak path. Flagged: no decision apportions the NFR-P-001 15-minute budget across hops.

DIAG-DEP.agent_summary: Deployment flowchart TB, 10 nodes + 5 nested boundaries, scoped to the six UoF-controlled components (not Full system). Depicts the AZRS contradictions rather than drawing the ADRs unchallenged: region subgraphs state zone posture literally (australiaeast zones YES/3/VERIFIED; australiasoutheast NO/CONFIRMED absent); F-1 Log Analytics styled in a contradiction class and deliberately NOT drawn as a resilience peer of Service Bus so the ADR-005 s7.2 inversion is visible; F-2 storage labelled as CONFIDENTIAL derived PI with GZRS continuous export as the fix; F-3 Entra drawn OUTSIDE the Australian jurisdiction boundary in offshore style with RBAC/PIM edges crossing inward, contradicting ADR-006 s8.3 and ADR-010 Tier 3. Three subscription subgraphs with identity boundary numbers and PI rules. Sandpit shown as an undesigned placeholder. Parse OK (flowchart-v2).

OPS.agent_summary: Teaching-calendar-differentiated support model with vendor management as a first-class tier (L0 = vendor). Rostered on-call confined to assessment/exam windows, cutovers and commencement week; 24/7 rejected as unfundable under ADR-003 Condition 4, plain business hours rejected against NFR-A-001. Service tier recorded as 'Important by requirement, Standard as staffed' with the gap named as a funding decision. 14 runbooks RB-01..RB-14. Top gaps: (1) no rostered responder against a MUST availability target whose chain arithmetic is never shown (~99.75% serial vs 99.9%) — target recorded as NOT demonstrated; (2) continuity concentrated in departing/unbacked individuals — R-007 course cloning 'None effective', SA departs 31 Aug with no handover against 44 open gating items, no backup for Sam Okafor; (3) monitoring plane less resilient than what it monitors (AZRS F-1) plus zero DR rehearsals — RB-09 written for operating blind. Handover checklist scores 0/38 by design. NDB never tabletopped.
